notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/snu-pi__humanoidtoolbench --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware was attached and no hardware or sim run is claimed. The package uses the card's family-config decision and GymnasiumDriver helper with the card's AST entry symbol humanoidtoolbench.envs.sonic_loco_manip:SonicLocoManipEnv, so there is no decision/helper deviation. It serves one of the 18 registered conditions, the documented default humanoidtoolbench/G1BallMove-L0-S; the other 17 are not served (one package is one device). The exposed action space is the environment's 43-joint controller Dict (6 left leg, 6 right leg, 3 waist, 7 left arm, 7 right arm, 7 left hand, 7 right hand), not the policy server's 36-value decoupled_v1 chunk. The fake backend is a pure-Python kinematic stand-in and was never compared with the upstream environment: it copies the commanded joint values into joint_qpos, applies the registered 3000-step TimeLimit truncation, and models no MuJoCo dynamics, contacts, actuator forces, layout or objects, tool selection, contact metrics, success/failure predicates, reward (it returns 0.0) or rendering. The real observation adds four camera streams (head_stereo_left, head_stereo_right, wrist_left, wrist_right), each 640 by 360 by 3 uint8; the fake returns only the 43-value joint_qpos (the real array sizes are named in fidelity.gaps). Fidelity is F0 for the fake: engine gymnasium:humanoidtoolbench/G1BallMove-L0-S, determinism seeded with seed_control parameter, timestep_ms 5.0 (the 0.005 s physics step; one cap.world.step.v1 tick is one 20 ms control step of four physics steps, declared in the gaps), realtime_factor 0, clock lockstep, reset full, snapshot_restore false. The sim backend was not run: it needs gymnasium, MuJoCo 3.11.0, torch 2.7.0, gear_sonic and decoupled-wbc, a GPU with EGL headless rendering, and a sonic_config from the evaluation CLI that the registration alone does not supply. Expected warnings from the last gate run: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the seed of the next reset) and ten G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived inputs (seed twice, ticks and the seven action arrays). G4 emitted no warning. Only cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue_requests and no site-limits.example.json (no operator_required bound). NOT COVERED: the four 640 by 360 by 3 uint8 camera streams, the MuJoCo rigid-body dynamics and contacts, the whole-body controller and actuator model, the task layout and objects, the success/failure predicates and reward, rendering, and the sim path.
